file_write.scope: Only scripts/run_short_dna_alignment.py may create private temporary input copies and alignment artifacts plus the caller-specified new SAM and JSON leaf files in the current working directory; it may not replace a path, escape the working directory, mutate an input, create user directories, or use the network.
file_write.reason: Private staging isolates the fixed adapter, and create-exclusive atomic publication prevents overwriting either requested artifact.

target_enforcement.openai: Allow only private temporary work plus the explicit new SAM and JSON leaf files in the working directory; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.claude: Allow only private temporary work plus the explicit new SAM and JSON leaf files in the working directory; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.generic: Run locally and allow only private staging plus the two caller-approved create-new outputs.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust plus explicit write approval is required for the two create-new outputs.

local_subprocess.scope: scripts/run_short_dna_alignment.py may execute only the caller-supplied absolute non-symlink executable after its SHA-256 matches, require exact minimap2 2.31-r1302, and use a fixed short-genomic-DNA argv, one thread, fixed seed, private cwd, clean environment, no stdin, no shell, no caller flags, no installation, and no fallback aligner.
local_subprocess.reason: Digest and version pinning plus a fixed argv makes minimap2 the sole bounded adapter and preserves fail-closed execution.

target_enforcement.openai: Permit only the digest-pinned fixed minimap2 invocation; reject shell expansion, caller flags, alternate tools, and version drift.
target_enforcement.claude: Permit only the digest-pinned fixed minimap2 invocation; reject shell expansion, caller flags, alternate tools, and version drift.
target_enforcement.generic: Execute only the fixed adapter after input, executable digest, and exact version validation.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust plus explicit local-process approval is required for the fixed minimap2 invocation.
